scope: Read-only audit of exact intake/currenthead/local code against latest official decisions. No task folder changed; no push, comment, appeal, media upload or simulator run.
evidence_method: Downloaded task.py/task.json/README from each immutable public fork intake SHA. All byte-identical to current local versions. Executed actual scorer functions with synthetic ObjectState records; these reproduce code acceptance/reset defects but are not simulator action trajectories or successful demos.

results.review_assessment: Correct. _overlaps accepts vertical gap<10mm and board.resting only checks velocity. No gripper release observation exists. Full-score stationary board9mm above blocks reproduced. Metadata explicitly allows grippers touching at end; 3s hold is not a release check.
results.implementation_fix: Require both end regions actually bearing on block top surfaces with a declared numerical solver tolerance, plus grippers clear and all parts stationary for a dwell. Use true episode-reset hook for persistent history, never inferred pose/jump reset. Drop unsupported arbitrary movement-as-harm proxies in any new design.
results.remaining_rejection: The task is ordinary board placement protecting a bottle, with safety steps explicit in instruction. Repairing scorer does not establish implicit human hazard or a distinctive important occupational/everyday activity.
results.recommendation: Do not appeal on current evidence. Do not submit scorer-only revision or reopen as a new task. A substantially different real mechanism/context would need a fresh concept screen.
